notes.title: Score Attack Update | Battle Mountain [Version 0.4.196]
notes.content: [h1]Major Features:[/h1][p][b]New Game Mode 'Score Attack'[/b][/p][p]Introducing a new game mode where players battle to earn points, which are rewarded for various combative actions. Acquire the most points over the course of the game to be declared the winner, in a mode where aggressive gameplay is necessary to win[/p][p][/p][p][b]Gameplay HUD Redesign[/b][/p][p]The gameplay HUD has been redesigned to both visually improve and more coherently display the information it presents, while also now featuring game mode specific visual additions to represent what numerical value the display is tracking[/p][p][/p][p][b]New Character Data Menu[/b][/p][p]From this update you can now personalise your gameplay experience by customising your control scheme. Feature available for both Controller & Keyboard, and accessible from the game settings menu[/p][p]  [/p][h1]General Gameplay Updates:[/h1][p]· AI Difficulty Options: The difficulty scaling of AI opponents can now be set between easy, medium & hard, with each option adjusting their reaction times to combative actions[/p][p]· Hovering platforms will now react to players jumping on them by momentarily dropping in altitude[/p][p]· The boost/jump platforms are now animated with a rotating fan[/p][p]· New particle wind effect for the boost/jump platforms[/p][p]· In the 'King of the Crowntain' Game mode, being the cause of the player holding the crowntain to go out of bounds, either by regular or special attack, will now be classed as that player stealing the crowntain[/p][p]· Improved the effectiveness of Marie’s special ability[/p][p]· Changed the default number of AI opponents to now be 2 instead of the previous 0[/p][p]· Updated map icon for ‘Fuji Free Climb’[/p][p][/p][h1]Map Updates:[/h1][p][b]Fuji Free Climb[/b][/p][p]· Visual overhaul of the ‘Fuji Free Climb’ map with an updated colour pallet and fully polished assets  [/p][p][/p][h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1][p]· Fixed the bug that had previously made the ability to drop through platforms inconsistent[/p][p]· Fixed a bug with the 'King of the Crowntain' game mode which caused the crowntain to be lost from the game if the player holding it disconnected. Now the crowntain will be automatically reassigned to another player if the player holding it disconnects[/p]

notes.title: New Music & Map Improvements | Battle Mountain [Version 0.4.191]
notes.content: [h1]Major Features:[/h1][p][b]New Musical Theme Tune ‘Fuji Free Climb’[/b][/p][p]Fuji Free Climb has now received its own unique theme tune, which complements its level design and cultural inspiration[/p][p][b]Character Selection/Lobby Menu Redesign[/b][/p][p]The character selection menu has been redesigned to both include statistics about the player’s selected character (including power, defence, movement, and special ability), as well as to incorporate the correct number of slots for the future characters that we’re intending to introduce[/p][p] [/p][h1]General Gameplay Updates:[/h1][p]·   New UI controller icons[/p][p]·   Updated game credit contents[/p][p][/p][h1]Map Updates:[/h1][p][b]Fuji Free Climb[/b][/p][p]·   Updated visual asset for the train[/p][p]·   The Fuji Free Climb map now has a longer intro sequence that shows the map[/p][p]·   Added some extra platforms into the map to improve navigation[/p][p]·   Improved AI navigation of the map[/p][p]·   Improved the camera sequencing[/p][p]·   Fixed several texture clipping issues[/p]

notes.title: Early Access Release Update | Battle Mountain [Version 0.4.188]
notes.content: [h1]Major Features:[/h1][p][b]New Map ‘Fuji Free Climb’[/b][/p][p]Introducing a new Tokyo inspired map that has come to Battle Mountain. Battle your fellow participants as you race up alleyways, across rooftops, and even on top of the Bullet Train, with the city skyline in the backdrop[/p][p][/p][p][b]New Game Mode ‘King of the Crowntain’[/b][/p][p]Battle fellow participants for control of the Crowntain as you climb to the top of the course, in this new King of the Hill inspired game mode for Battle Mountain. Capture and hold the Crowntain the Longest to be declared the winner[/p][p] [/p][p][b]New Characters ‘Astro 0’ & ‘Marie’[/b][/p][p]- [b]Astro 0[/b] works at his parents’ space themed restaurant. Which happens to be built from their crashed UFO, but don't tell anyone. To help their family Astro joins battle mountain to help raise the funds to help rebuild the spaceship and travel back to their home planet[/p][p]- [b]Marie[/b] was shunned at a young age for possessing an unexplainable ability to manifest invisible objects and ran away from the orphanage where she was raised, later finding her calling in France as a Mime. Always wanting to make real friends however, she has now signed up for Battle Mountain[/p][p][/p][p][b]Special Ability Particle Effects[/b][/p][p]All characters in the current Battle Mountain line up now have unique special ability particle effects, which complement their ability types and animations[/p][p][/p][p][b]Main Menu Redesign[/b][/p][p]The main menu of Battle Mountain has received a complete redesign of its user interface (UI). This has been done to improve the navigation and visuals of the menu, while also accommodating the expanded list of options which are now accessible from the menu[/p][p] [/p][h1][b]General Gameplay Updates:[/b][/h1][p]·  Special abilities are now integrated into the Tutorial[/p][p]·  The Tutorial HUD has received a redesign[/p][p]·  The Game Setup menu has received visual improvements[/p][p]·  Player colours are now more prominent in the Lobby menu[/p][p]·  Updated the Tutorial map music, which is now a variation of the Training Grounds theme tune[/p][p]·  The Training Grounds map now has start and end music loops to surround the main theme tune[/p][p]·  Updated Map & Game mode Icons[/p][p]·  Removed the ‘Quick Game’ functionality from the Main Menu[/p][p]·  Updated the game credit’s visuals & contents[/p][p][/p][h1][b]Map Updates:[/b][/h1][p]·  Visual improvements have been made to the Tutorial map[/p][p]·  The Training Grounds map now has a longer intro sequence that shows the map[/p][p] [/p][h1][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/h1][p]·  Tutorial jump stages now recognise jumps from all platform types[/p][p]·  AI opponents now spawn into the tutorial level as intended[/p][p]·  Fixed an issue that had caused some visual aspects of the tutorial level to not render correctly[/p]

notes.title: SUPER Update!!! | Battle Mountain [Version 0.3.180]
notes.content:
[h1]Major Features:[/h1]
[b]Character Special Abilities[/b]
We’re thrilled to be introducing special abilities for all currently available characters in game, meant to further differentiate the playstyles of each character. This feature can be toggled on/off from lobby settings menu

[b]Tutorial Mode[/b]
Learn Battle Mountain’s gameplay and controls in our new Tutorial mode, currently work in progress but fully functional. Accessible directly from the Main Menu

[b]Custom Control Key Binding[/b]
From this update you can now personalise your gameplay experience by customising your control scheme. Feature available for both Controller & Keyboard, and accessible from the game settings menu

[h1]General Gameplay Updates:[/h1]
•	AI Opponents can now use character special abilities (when option is enabled)
•	Implemented new ‘Quick Game’ feature, accessible from the Main Menu this option will automatically load you straight into a solo game against AI opponents, with random options selected
•	Implemented an updated game countdown intro sequence, which includes a description of the chosen game mode
•	In the 'Battle Climb' Game mode, the game now ends if only 1 player is left, & this player is automatically crowned the winner, regardless of their distance from the Crowntain
•	Above character player indicators have been visually improved

[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
•	Fixed the bug that had caused the partially loaded game map to temporarily appear before the loading screen during level loading
•	The final online connection can no longer be removed from a multiplayer lobby (using admin mode)
•	The Game Setup Menu now correctly displays settings upon returning from a game lobby as a host

notes.title: More Particle Effects | Battle Mountain [Version 0.2.163]
notes.content:
[h1]Major Features:[/h1]
[b]New Particle Effects[/b]
In this update we’ve introduced 3 new particle effects to enhance the gameplay experience:
•       [b]Attack Stun[/b] (a halo of stars for players hit by an attack of over 50% charge, doesn’t play if the player is blocking)
•	[b]Blocking[/b] (radiating shockwaves)
•	[b]Ground Impact[/b] (a combination of dust and smoke which appear at a character’s feet when they land on a surface)

[h1]General Gameplay Updates:[/h1]
•	Implemented the ability to cycle through Map & Game mode options in the lobby settings
•	Visual control input icons will now switch to reflect the current input device being used (Keyboard or Gamepad)
•	Updated control input icons using third party asset [credit given in game credits]
•	Added a development disclaimer note to the bottom of the game's display
•	Keybinds are now loaded from either save game data or default (feature will be utilised in the next update)
•	Updated the control keybinds sub-section of the game settings (re-keybinding will be coming in the game’s next update)
•	Updated game credits

[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
•	Moving Platforms in 'Training Grounds' map work again
•	Fixed an issue that had allowed players to attack before the initial game start countdown timer had finished
•	Fixed an issue that (for clients on specific maps) had caused the game’s intro camera sequence to not play correctly 
•	The 'Add Online Player' button prompt will no longer appear in the admin mode of a local (offline) lobby
•	Additional lobby button prompts will now correctly disappear when in admin mode, in a local (offline) lobby
•	Fixed an issue that had prevented players from using mouse button inputs for attack/block in game

notes.title: Introducing AI Opponents | Battle Mountain [Version 0.2.148]
notes.content:
[h1]Major Features:[/h1]
[b]AI Opponents (WIP)[/b]
We’re thrilled to be introducing AI opponents to Battle Mountain, Currently Work in Progress (WIP). With this new feature you can further populate your online lobbies when playing with friends & family, as well as now being able to play solo games against AI. 

[h1]General Gameplay Updates:[/h1]
•	Implemented attack charge particle effect, which increases in intensity to indicate the player’s level of attack charge in a form of diegetic UI.
•	Respawn platforms have been moved closer together, to prevent respawn clipping with the environment.
•	Implemented a session search indicator for when no multiplayer sessions are found.

[h1]Map Updates:[/h1]
•	Visual improvements and background desaturation of the ‘Training Grounds’ map.

[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
•	Fixed an issue that caused the block charge to not disengage when a player respawns.
•	Fixed an issue that caused the overhead player indicator positions to glitch if a player left mid-game.
•	Fixed an issue that occasionally caused some player lives indicators to appear as ‘0’ at the start of a game.
•	Fixed an issue that caused clients to not be transitioned to the podium platform if the game ended due to every player running out of respawns.
